headline: Jaeha Kim explains structural and functional SystemVerilog model generation using a pipelined ADC
fact: In an IEEE Silicon Valley SSCS-sponsored webinar, Jaeha Kim explains automatic SystemVerilog model extraction using a pipelined ADC example. Structural modeling maps circuit devices and connectivity into models, retaining a low abstraction level that limits speed improvement. Functional modeling maps selected circuit regions to predefined templates and requires manual input. The resource record lists a recording and slides. This is a demonstrated modeling workflow, not evidence of fully automatic abstraction of arbitrary analog circuits or deployment at a named customer.
